{"title": "createReminder stores weekly reminders with an unknown zone, so listing them panics", "body": "Fingerprint fp_81cd67, report cr_d8878a (3 panics, v1.4.0, commit 9c41e7a). GET /v1/reminders panics with nil pointer dereference at schedule/weekly.go:114 (Weekly.MarshalJSON reads w.Zone.Name), reached through api.listReminders -> writeJSON -> viewOf.

Cause: api/reminders.go createReminder takes the zone from req.TZ or the user's prefs and calls schedule.LookupZone(name). LookupZone returns nil for a name it can't load (for example "Mars/Olympus"). createReminder doesn't check for nil, so schedule.Parse builds a Weekly with a nil Zone and the reminder is stored. The crash comes later, when the list is rendered. Weekly.Next and Location() tolerate a nil zone, so the crash only shows up in MarshalJSON.

Fix: createReminder now returns 400 "unknown time zone ..." when LookupZone returns nil, so no reminder with a nil zone is stored. Reproducer: api/tz_test.go TestCreateRejectsUnknownZone (fails before the fix with status 201, passes after).

Note: reminders already stored with a nil zone by v1.4.0 will still panic when listed. Those need a data cleanup or a separate migration; this issue does not cover that.", "fingerprint": "fp_81cd67", "root_cause": {"file": "api/reminders.go", "function": "(*API).createReminder"}, "reproducer": {"file": "api/tz_test.go", "function": "TestCreateRejectsUnknownZone"}}
